precisionClarification.finding: The frozen empty response records absence of an unambiguous physically correct answer. A blind raw-number execution of the source metre-assuming print would output2.50cm even when supplied values actually mean millimetres; that value would be mislabeled, and the keyed explanation silently treats the inputs as metres. Preserve this distinction rather than asserting the program cannot print the offered string.
